headline: Khaitan & Co assists Gallagher Centre of Excellence on leasing offices in Bengaluru, Gurugram, Pune
sum: Khaitan & Co advised Gallagher Centre of Excellence LLP on acquisition of leasehold rights in commercial office spaces across three key metropolitan locations across India. Bengaluru, Karnataka: Office space admeasuring 58,189 square feet…
detail: Khaitan & Co advised Gallagher Centre of Excellence LLP on acquisition of leasehold rights in commercial office spaces across three key metropolitan locations across India. Bengaluru, Karnataka: Office space admeasuring 58,189 square feet in commercial building known as ‘Godrej Hebbal' situated in Byatarayanapura Village, Yelahanka Hobli, Bangalore North (Additional) Taluk, Bangalore, Karnataka; Gurugram, Haryana: Office space admeasuring approximately 40,252 square feet in Block C, Building No 8, DLF Cyber City, Gurugram; Pune, Maharashtra: (a) Office space admeasuring in aggregate 34,965 square feet and 10,936 square feet situated in the IT Park/Commercial Complex, known as “Gigaspace IT…
